Hearing On The Petition To Approve The Compromise Of A Disputed Claim Of A Minor.
Off Calendar Feb-19-2009 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for hearing on the Petition to Approve the Compromise of a Disputed Claim of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Comm. William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Kevin Sullivan, Esq. appeared with petitioner Juana Rodriguez, who was present as Guardian ad litem for the minor Bryan Hernandez, who was also present at today's hearing.
Petitioner was placed under oath and examined.
Gladys Monge was placed under oath and served as Spanish speaking interpreter for petitioner.
No appearance by defendant San Francisco Unified School District.

On the basis of evidence received, and good cause appearing, the Petition is granted and compromise is approved.

Settlement Amount - $10,000.00.
Attorney's Fees - $2,314.43.
Medical Expenses - $742.28.
Costs - $694.49.

A net balance of $6,248.80 shall be deposited into a blocked account with Wells Fargo Bank, located at 2595 Mission Street, San Francisco, CA 94110. No withdrawals shall be made without a written Court Order or until the minor reaches the age of 18 years.

Orders Approving the Compromise of a Disputed Claim of an Minor, and to Deposit Money Into a Blocked Account, were submitted to and signed by the Court.
